descriptions.d31j_reload_saved_items_8017ce10: Formats the file name from the object's format string and the kind, runs the file and queries its holder; for each stored node finds the named entry, compares kind and size and tests two states; on a clean match commits the node and replaces the entry reference inside a protected section, otherwise returns 0x80004005 with discarded string copies. Reports progress through a callback. If the file cannot run, clears the kind's table slot.
